annotations.title: Trace a product, lot or container

description: Trace a Serial, Lot or container through the repository as the signed-in user. backward: what it was made from (the TransformationEvents that output it, then their inputs, level by level) and the container it was packed in; forward: what was made from it and what it was packed into, down to where each result was last seen. Every step names its eventID, Read Point and time. A Lot is class level (/10/), a Serial or SSCC instance level. A returnable asset (GRAI, /8003/) or an individual asset (GIAI, /8004/), such as a minecart, a pack donkey or a bottle, answers what it carries now (every ADD minus every DELETE of the AggregationEvents it is the parent of), where it was last seen and its latest events.

identifier.description: the identifier, a GS1 Digital Link (01, 00, 8003, 8004) or EPC URN
